fact: The Digital Transformation Project unit (UG PTN) launched an international tender to connect governorate and territory administrative buildings, with a pilot covering seven governorates and 44 of 145 territories via LEO satellite internet and a VPN to the GovNet hub in Kinshasa, financed by the World Bank and AFD.
title: Connectivité des bâtiments administratifs de Gouvernorats et de 145 territoires : Phase pilote sept (7) Gouvernorats et 44 territoires
